pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 12
   D. 11

2. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 3

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 12

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

6. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 1

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

12. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: 28
